verdict.rationale: HMRC runs online services and a production API platform, so bulk operations are a fair question for this product. However, no evidence describes batch or bulk actions across many items. The evidence covers individual registrations, sign-ups, agent sign-up on a client's behalf and filing through compatible software, none of which is a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
